questions.prompt: The mass listed on the periodic table is…
choices: A weighted average of the isotopes
The mass of the heaviest isotope
questions.explain: It's a weighted average over the natural isotope mixture.

questions.prompt: An element is 50% mass-10 and 50% mass-11. What is the average atomic mass?
Chlorine is 75% mass-35 and 25% mass-37. Average? (0.75×35 + 0.25×37)
An element is 20% mass-10 and 80% mass-11. Average?
If an element is 90% a light isotope and 10% a heavy one, the average is…
questions.explain: The average is pulled toward the more abundant (light) isotope.

questions.prompt: Every single chlorine atom weighs 35.45 u.
questions.explain: 35.45 is an average; individual atoms are ~35 or ~37.
Use the element picker to choose chlorine.

questions.prompt: Load chlorine and set an even 50/50 mix (use “Make all equal”). The average should land near 36.
questions.explain: A 50/50 split of ~35 and ~37 averages to ~36 — the plain midpoint.
